about: Dave Wishnew is an attorney who represents clients in the Dallas, Texas area. Dave Wishnew is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2020 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Dave Wishnew chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended The University of Texas School of Law and graduated in 2008. Dave Wishnew passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2008.
He represents clients with Business Litigation issues in Texas. He also represents clients with Employment & Labor: Employee, Employment & Labor: Employer and General Litigation issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Dave Wishnew has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
